additional_info.subject: ID0455749-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001234] Dispenser Warning - Selftest has failed CRM:03056000196
additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe, good morning.
Sorry for the delay.
For this error it's usually removed after a reboot, this only relates to a check performed on the dispenser fans which doesn't cause any operation problem.
Are you able to perform a reboot or should I? From my point of view it's not a critical problem since the fan should be working.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
